title: Tunnel co-occurrence mining contract (L3)
description: Hebbian-style forward tunnel mining from solver co-fire events. See ADR-042.

invariants.name: jaccard_trust_formula
must: max() denominator (NOT min, NOT product) -- conservative bound

invariants.name: threshold_matches_adr_038
invariants.description: Mined tunnel trust_score MUST equal Jaccard trust; tunnel accepted only when >= 0.70 (ADR-038 TUN-001).
must: tunnel.trust_score == Jaccard trust at write time

invariants.name: bidirectional_emission
invariants.description: Co-fire mines BOTH directions (A->B AND B->A).
must: miner emits two tunnel records per qualifying pair
each tunnel has its own provenance_event_id (the most recent dispatch event)

invariants.name: same_lifecycle_as_adr_038
invariants.description: Mined tunnels use ADR-038 TUN-007 lifecycle (30-day revalidation, 90-day archive).
must: mined and operator-edited tunnels have identical lifecycle

out_of_scope: Query-class normalization helper (assumed shared with ADR-032)
Operator dashboard for mined tunnels (future PR)
